variant.displayName: Alliance Aid: Double Interstellar Med. Haul (Medical / Filters)
variant.briefing:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of Molina Mold treatment on microtech and shipment of ventilation filters on Hurston waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to [Destination]. 
 
To handle the cargo, your ship should be big enough to carry cargo containers up to [MissionMaxSCUSize] in size. 

And I would double check to make sure you have your handheld tractor beam with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!  

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
